_label: SECTION 1 HIDDEN ROLE CLAIMS — FIXTURE-REQUIRED BATCH 1

scope.included: The 39 fixture-required Ascendant and guiding-planet nakshatra/pada routes in the 10-chart Section 1 test set.
scope.excluded: This is not universal coverage of all 27 nakshatras and 108 padas for both roles.
scope.unresolved: The remaining 22 fixture-required routes: 10 guiding-planet signs and 12 conjunction/dispositor/drishti routes.

governingRules: These are new role-specific claims derived from neutral source models; Section 2 Moon application claims are not reused.
The technical layer remains visible in internal trace but silent in customer prose.
Only Section 1 may orient the customer to rising sign, guiding planet and house; it must not repeatedly teach nakshatra or pada.
All claims remain development-only until a practitioner approves both the underlying model and its use for this role.
The writer must use ordinary language understandable across education levels.
